environment: Disposable PostgreSQL with minimal local Auth stand-in; not hosted email or JWT sessions

tests.name: Complete migration chain applies from an empty database
Two-person group cannot bypass the four-person minimum
Signed-out planning API is denied
Unrelated user cannot read planning state
Unrelated user cannot mutate guessed trip
Six-person full core costs match playbook fixture exactly
Boat attendee alone receives add-on and its contingency
Planning reads disclose no raw group input or other personal costs
Direct private planning table read is denied
Internal evaluator cannot be invoked by an ordinary caller
Member cannot select or publish a group plan
Client prices and forged actor fields are rejected
Unknown catalogue option is rejected
Foreign travel window cannot be prepared
Only one current open poll is allowed
Early poll closure requires every ballot
An open poll blocks publication
Stale ballot cannot overwrite a later ballot
Live vote totals are hidden; each member can read only own ballot
Foreign poll reference is rejected
Tied vote selects lower shared upper cost and never confirms the trip
Concurrent publication creates one canonical version from separate connections
Idempotency key cannot be reused with changed input
Repeated publication creates one immutable server-controlled version
Readiness requires complete estimate acknowledgement
Private change reasons are absent from organiser responses
Stale response cannot replace current intent
Five of six ready cannot produce agreement
All six current ready responses allow explicit organiser agreement
Repeated closure records one canonical agreement outcome
Published snapshots reject administrative update attempts
Saved cost snapshots reject mutation
Concurrent closure and withdrawal cannot leave a declined trip agreed
Declining withdraws agreement without silently removing membership or roster
Forged response identity is rejected
Five-person roster reprices three rooms and vehicle; INR 11,462 breaches fixture ceiling
Over-budget arrangement cannot enter review
Old six-person plan cannot receive a new response
Unverified hard accessibility requirement blocks both options
Unsupported origin is an unknown critical price, never a zero cost
Changed private input makes an old poll unusable
All abstentions remain unresolved and cannot fabricate a winning choice
A new plan version retains history and starts with no carried-over approvals
Foreign published version cannot accept a response
Votes after the deadline are rejected
Deadline closure counts missing ballots separately and does not infer readiness
A traveller may withdraw earlier readiness after the deadline, ending agreement
Expired response deadline cannot accept new readiness
Expired deadline cannot silently close as agreement
Explicit deadline extension preserves history and requires fresh review
A request for a different option leaves the choice unresolved
Catalogue critical unknown invalidates readiness and agreement
Postponement cannot become agreement from old readiness
All 24 application tables have RLS and private tables deny direct access
Residual paise allocation sums exactly to the shared charge
